note: DCs: total dendritic cells (conventional and plasmacytoid; cDC vs pDC subtypes are not split in this workflow) — two distinct sub-clusters captured by a single polygon: a CD11c+ CD123- cluster at the lower-right (cDC) and a CD11c- CD123+ cluster at the upper-left (pDC). The lower-left double-negative corner is excluded.
tips: DCs: CD11c+ AND/OR CD123+ (cDC are CD11c+ CD123-, pDC are CD11c- CD123+; this gate captures both with a single polygon). Useful co-markers: HLA-DR+ is a DC hallmark and already enforced by the upstream parent chain; CD1c_Dy162Di and BDCA3_Dy164Di (BDCA3/CD141) are available in panel and would resolve cDC1 (BDCA3+) vs cDC2 (CD1c+) if needed; CD33_Nd142Di confirms myeloid lineage (cDCs are CD33+, lower than monocytes); CD14_Eu151Di should be negative/low on DCs — useful as a negative check to exclude residual monocytes that leaked past Step 7; CD11b_Eu153Di is generally low/negative on DCs.
